title: Inheritance and Verdict Revisited
author: Marguerite Lockridge
blurb: Tamsin Villalobos, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
